content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues downloading an update by any method—whether through the app or directly from the website. The app shows an error (see attachment), and both 32- and 64-bit versions fail similarly. When downloading directly, I'm prompted to select a folder but cannot proceed further. The download always stops before the progress bar completes; although the file should be about 140 MB, I only receive around 75 MB. I have tried Internet Explorer, Chrome, Firefox, and my Android device, but the issue persists. Please advise. Thank you.

Hello [user_name], Could you please specify which Windows operating system you are using? First, please follow the steps from this FAQ: How do you perform an upgrade, update, or extension for [product_name] via the Update Center? Second, to address your issue, refer to the steps outlined in this FAQ: How to install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name] with or without the related software already installed? If you're on Windows 7, check this FAQ as well: Why do you receive an error message when installing an update or upgrade for [product_name] on Windows 7? Hope these resources are helpful. Best regards, [user_name]

Good morning, It seems the download service is now restored, as I was able to successfully download and install the update today without any issues. I did not change anything from my previous attempts. Thank you! Windows 7 Professional, Service Pack 1.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced repeated failures when attempting to download an update for [product_name] through both the application and official website, with incomplete downloads and persistent prompts. The issue was tested with multiple browsers and devices, and was ultimately resolved the next day, suggesting the root cause was likely a temporary service interruption affecting reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the update and download process for [product_name] to be reliable and seamless across various methods and browsers, and for download services to remain consistently available.
